Home / Navigation / Navbar

Navbar

The navbar provides a responsive navigation header with support for branding, links, dropdowns, search, forms, text, actions, and a mobile hamburger menu.

How it works

  • Navbars require a wrapping .zak-navbar with a zak-navbar-expand{-sm|-md|-lg|-xl|-xxl} class for responsive collapsing, and a color scheme class (zak-navbar-light or zak-navbar-dark).
  • Navbars and their contents are fluid by default; place a zak-container (or a fixed-width variant) inside to limit their horizontal extent. Leave the container out to span the full viewport.
  • Add a zak-navbar-toggler button with .zak-icon-menu/.zak-icon-close for the hamburger icon swap and wrap the collapsible content in a zak-navbar-collapse.
  • Mark the navbar with data-zak-navbar and include zak.js. The hamburger toggles the menu, sets aria-expanded, and closes on link click, outside click, and Escape.
  • Use .zak-navbar-nav for links, .zak-navbar-search for search forms, .zak-nav-link.active for the current page, and .zak-nav-link.disabled (with aria-disabled="true") for disabled items.

Supported content

Navbars come with built-in support for a handful of sub-components. Choose from brand, nav links, dropdowns, search forms, text, and action buttons.

                    <li><a href="#" class="zak-nav-link active">Home</a></li>

                <div class="zak-navbar-actions">
                    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-sm">Button</button>
                </div>
            </div>

</nav>

Placement

Use placement classes to position the navbar in the layout. zak-navbar-fixed pins it to the top of the viewport, zak-navbar-fixed-bottom to the bottom, and zak-navbar-sticky keeps it visible while scrolling.

  • Home
  • Link

<nav class="zak-navbar zak-navbar-fixed zak-navbar-expand-lg">...</nav>        <!-- pinned to top -->
<nav class="zak-navbar zak-navbar-fixed-bottom zak-navbar-expand-lg">...</nav> <!-- pinned to bottom -->
<nav class="zak-navbar zak-navbar-sticky zak-navbar-expand-lg">...</nav>       <!-- sticky top -->

Scrolling

For long link lists set a max-height on .zak-navbar-nav with .zak-navbar-nav-scroll. Below the expand breakpoint the menu scrolls vertically once it exceeds the height; at and above the breakpoint the expanded nav renders without scrolling.

Responsive behaviors

Expand classes mirror Bootstrap's behavior. A navbar without an expand class never expands: the toggler and stacked menu are shown at every size. Add zak-navbar-expand to always expand: the menu is inline and the hamburger hidden at every size. Use zak-navbar-expand-{sm|md|lg|xl|xxl} to expand at and above the matching breakpoint; below it the menu collapses behind a hamburger and stacks full-width when opened.

ClassExpands at
.zak-navbarNever (hamburger always visible)
.zak-navbar-expandAlways (hamburger hidden)
.zak-navbar-expand-sm≥ 576px
.zak-navbar-expand-md≥ 768px
.zak-navbar-expand-lg≥ 992px
.zak-navbar-expand-xl≥ 1200px
.zak-navbar-expand-xxl≥ 1400px

With data-zak-navbar + zak.js, clicking the toggler opens the stacked menu, the icon swaps to the close icon, and aria-expanded stays in sync. Actions placed in .zak-navbar-actions stay visible at all sizes.

CSS Classes

Navbar styles are controlled through these CSS classes.

HTML
/* Navbar Container */
.zak-navbar                /* Base navbar (no expand class = never expand) */
.zak-navbar-light          /* Light background */
.zak-navbar-dark           /* Dark background */

/* Expand behavior */
.zak-navbar-expand         /* Always expand (inline at every size) */
.zak-navbar-expand-sm      /* Expand at/above sm = 576px */
.zak-navbar-expand-md      /* Expand at/above md = 768px */
.zak-navbar-expand-lg      /* Expand at/above lg = 992px */
.zak-navbar-expand-xl      /* Expand at/above xl = 1200px */
.zak-navbar-expand-xxl     /* Expand at/above xxl = 1400px */

/* Positioning */
.zak-navbar-fixed           /* Fixed to top of viewport */
.zak-navbar-fixed-bottom    /* Fixed to bottom of viewport */
.zak-navbar-sticky          /* Sticky to top on scroll */
.zak-navbar-sticky-bottom   /* Sticky to bottom on scroll */

/* Navbar Parts */
.zak-navbar-inner          /* Flex layout container (wrap + space-between) */
.zak-navbar-brand          /* Brand/logo link (images/svg sized to 2rem) */
.zak-navbar-toggler        /* Hamburger menu button (uses .zak-icon-menu/.zak-icon-close for icon swap) */
.zak-navbar-collapse       /* Collapsible nav content (below breakpoint) */
.zak-navbar-search         /* Search form wrapper */
.zak-navbar-actions        /* Right-aligned actions (visible at all sizes) */
.zak-navbar-text           /* Plain text block inside the navbar */
.zak-navbar-nav-scroll     /* Vertically scrollable nav list (when collapsed) */
.zak-navbar-menu           /* Legacy alias for collapse */

/* Navigation Links */
.zak-navbar-nav            /* Nav link list */
.zak-nav-link              /* Individual nav link (scoped to .zak-navbar) */
.zak-nav-link.active       /* Active state */
.zak-nav-link.disabled     /* Disabled state (also via aria-disabled="true") */
.zak-nav-dropdown          /* Dropdown parent */

/* Centered layouts */
.zak-navbar-center         /* Center the collapse contents (no brand) */
.zak-navbar-nav-center     /* Center the nav links inside the collapse */
.zak-navbar-actions-end    /* Push actions to the right of the collapse */

/* Mobile */
.zak-open                /* Mobile menu open state (toggled by JS) */
.zak-navbar-active       /* Alias open state for JS-driven navbars */
.zak-navbar-menu-active  /* Open state on collapse/menu element */
.zak-icon-menu           /* Hamburger icon (shown when closed) */
.zak-icon-close          /* Close icon (shown when open) */

JavaScript

Include zak.js and mark the navbar with data-zak-navbar. It auto-wires the hamburger toggle, sets aria-expanded, and closes the menu on link click, outside click, and Escape.

HTML
<nav class="zak-navbar zak-navbar-light zak-navbar-expand-lg" data-zak-navbar>
  ...
</nav>

<script src="path/to/zak.js"></script>

The expand behavior mirrors Bootstrap: a navbar without an expand class never expands, zak-navbar-expand always expands, and zak-navbar-expand-{sm|md|lg|xl|xxl} expands at its breakpoint. Below the expand breakpoint the toggler shows a hamburger menu; at or above it the menu is laid out inline and the toggler is hidden. The zak.navbar API is also available for manual control:

HTML
zak.navbar.open(navbar);      // open the mobile menu
zak.navbar.close(navbar);     // close the mobile menu
zak.navbar.toggle(navbar);    // toggle open/closed
zak.navbar.isExpanded(navbar);// true at/above the navbar's expand breakpoint

Accessibility

Follow these accessibility best practices when using navbars.

  • Use <nav> element with aria-label="Main navigation" for the primary navbar.
  • Use the hamburger button's aria-label="Toggle navigation" for screen readers.
  • Mark the current page with aria-current="page" on the active link.
  • Mark disabled links with aria-disabled="true" (the .disabled class alone is not enough).
  • Ensure the mobile menu has role="navigation" when expanded.
  • Close the mobile menu on Escape key press.
  • Manage focus trap inside the open mobile menu for keyboard navigation.
HTML
<nav class="zak-navbar zak-navbar-light zak-navbar-expand-lg" data-zak-navbar aria-label="Main navigation">
    <div class="zak-container">
        <div class="zak-navbar-inner">
            <a href="#" class="zak-navbar-brand">Brand</a>
            <button class="zak-navbar-toggler" aria-label="Toggle navigation" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="navbar-collapse">
                <svg class="zak-icon zak-icon-menu" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true">
                    <path d="M3 12h18M3 6h18M3 18h18"/>
                </svg>
                <svg class="zak-icon zak-icon-close" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true">
                    <path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12"/>
                </svg>
            </button>
            <div class="zak-navbar-collapse" id="navbar-collapse" role="navigation">
                <ul class="zak-navbar-nav">
                    <li><a href="#" class="zak-nav-link active" aria-current="page">Home</a></li>
                    <li><a href="#" class="zak-nav-link">Features</a></li>
                </ul>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</nav>
